quick_facts.label: What the job is
quick_facts.value: Quality control systems managers plan, direct or coordinate quality assurance programmes, and set quality control policies for laboratory and production work.

quick_facts.label: Other names for it
quick_facts.value: Job titles O*NET reports for this occupation (Quality Control Systems Managers) include Quality Assurance Manager (QA Manager), Quality Control Manager (QC Manager), Quality Director and Quality and Process Improvement Manager.

quick_facts.label: Typical preparation
quick_facts.value: O*NET places this occupation in Job Zone Four (considerable preparation needed): most of these occupations require a four-year bachelor's degree, but some do not.

sections.heading: What a quality manager does
paragraphs: Quality control systems managers plan, direct or coordinate quality assurance programmes, and set quality control policies for laboratory and production work.

The tasks below are taken from the O*NET profile for Quality Control Systems Managers. O*NET is the US Department of Labor's occupation database, so this describes the job as it is profiled in the United States; titles and duties in Indian companies can differ.
bullets: Stop production if serious product defects are present.
Review and update standard operating procedures and quality manuals.
Monitor how well the quality control systems are working.
Analyse quality test results and explain them to production staff.
